context: The community singing group meets every Wednesday. Mrs. Mori has been bringing Sachiko (visiting again) to sit in.
purpose: community ritual — two elders moving through a small social space

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: さちこさん、今日も元気そう。
lines.en: Sachiko-san — you look well today too.
lines.style: Bright Kansai opener. Helps her with the coat in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: おかげさまで。…本当に、ここ、楽しいわ。
lines.en: Thanks to you. …Really, this place is nice.
lines.style: Slow soft warmth. Pleased to be there.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: やろ？歌うとな、本当に、心が軽くなる。
lines.en: Right? When you sing — your heart really gets lighter.
lines.style: A small philosophy. Kansai economy — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そう思う。年取ってから、なお。
lines.en: I think so too. Even more, as you get older.
lines.style: A small honest agreement. Voice quiet.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 今日、一緒に歌ってくれる？
lines.en: Going to sing with us today?
lines.style: A small invitation that's really a claim.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: I wonder if my voice will come out… but yes, gladly.
lines.style: Half-laugh, half-real concern. Steps forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 本当に、嬉しい。みんなも喜ぶ。
lines.en: Really — I'm so happy. Everyone will be pleased.
lines.style: Real warmth. Pats her arm in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こちらこそ。…一緒の時間、楽しみ。
lines.style: A small graceful line. Voice softened.
